reasons.text: Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 60% of months
62% of feedstock comes from collectors invoicing far beyond their declared capacity
Category III share of certificates is 50%, +48% versus what its process route can produce
57% of all certificates were generated in a single month
24% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
89% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.83x the cost floor)

inspection_checklist: Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Visit the named collectors: confirm premises, vehicles and storage; check their registration dates and sales to other buyers.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
